purpose.sedge-spread: Wide low interlocking rosettes with folded curved leaves, ochre old blades and irregular edge.
purpose.sedge-crescent: One-sided swept low leaves open toward nearby passages; distinct silhouette.
purpose.rush-fan: Curving upright stems with cascading leaves and a broad rooted base, no harvest seed heads.
purpose.fern-bower: Broad arching fronds with individual paired leaflets form the middle layer.
purpose.root-weave: Low braided rotten roots threaded with small living leaves; entirely supported dressing.

design_purpose.sedge_blades: Ninety-six folded leaves connect several growing points into a spreading patch.
design_purpose.rush_stems: Twenty-one curved upright stems give a readable fan with gaps.
design_purpose.fern_fronds: Nine arching compound fronds fill a broad middle-layer silhouette.
